description: This file defines a factory function `buildCrudController` that creates a set of CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) controller methods for a Mongoose model. It handles list retrieval with pagination, filtering, sorting, tenant enforcement, caching, and error handling, as well as methods for getting by ID, creating, updating, and deleting documents. It appears to be part of a backend API for a multi-tenant application.

methods.name: validateSort(sort, allowed = ['timestamp', 'created_at', '_id'])
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes a sort string against an allowed list to prevent unindexed heavy sorts.

methods.name: clampLimit(limit, max = 500)
methods.description: Enforces a maximum limit on page size for safety.

methods.name: microGet(key)
methods.description: Retrieves a cached response for a list request if it exists and is not expired.

methods.name: microSet(key, payload)
methods.description: Stores a response in cache for a list request with a TTL.

methods.name: buildListKey(req, filter, sort, page, limit, skip, explicit)
methods.description: Constructs a stable cache key for list requests based on request parameters.

methods.name: sanitizePayloadWithTenant(req)
methods.description: Sanitizes request payloads for create/update by enforcing tenant_id from request context.

methods.name: mergeFilterWithTenant(filter, tenantId)
methods.description: Merges incoming filter with tenant enforcement, ignoring client-supplied tenant keys.

methods.name: mapAndReplyError(res, err, context = 'operation')
methods.description: Maps database errors to user-friendly API responses.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles listing documents with pagination, filtering, sorting, tenant filtering, caching, and error handling.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a single document by ID, enforcing tenant access.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new document after sanitizing payload and tenant enforcement.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a document by ID with tenant enforcement.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a document by ID with tenant enforcement.
